title: A Comedy of Estimators: On KL Regularization in RL Training of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2512.21852v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) can be substantially improved by training them with reinforcement learning (RL). The RL objective for LLM training involves a regularization term, which is the reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the trained policy and the reference policy. Since computing the KL divergence exactly is intractable, various estimators are used in practice to estimate it from on-policy samples. Despite its wide adoption, including in several open-source libraries, there is no systematic study analyzing the numerous ways of incorporating KL estimators in the objective and their effect on the downstream performance of RL-trained models. Recent works show that prevailing practices for incorporating KL regularization do not provide correct gradients for stated objectives, creating a discrepancy between the objective and its implementation. In this paper, we further analyze these practice

translated_title: 估计器喜剧：论大语言模型RL训练中的KL正则化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.21852v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：通过强化学习（RL）训练大型语言模型（LLMs）可以显著提升其推理性能。LLM训练的RL目标包含一个正则化项，即训练策略与参考策略之间的反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度。由于精确计算KL散度是不可行的，实践中使用各种估计器从策略内样本中估计它。尽管该方法被广泛采用，包括在多个开源库中，但缺乏系统性研究来分析在目标中纳入KL估计器的多种方式及其对RL训练模型下游性能的影响。近期研究表明，纳入KL正则化的主流实践并未为目标声明提供正确的梯度，导致目标与其实现之间存在差异。在本文中，我们进一步分析了这些实践。
tldr: 本文系统分析了LLM强化学习训练中KL正则化估计器的各种实现方式，揭示了主流实践存在梯度不匹配问题，并深入探讨了其影响。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes various KL regularization estimator implementations in RL training of LLMs, revealing gradient mismatches in prevailing practices and exploring their implications.
